---

## Slot Checkpointing & KV Cache Save/Restore — Full Audit

### 1. Three Independent Cache/Checkpoint Mechanisms

The server has **three distinct** mechanisms for KV cache reuse:

| Mechanism | Scope | Persistence | Trigger |
|-----------|-------|-------------|---------|
| **Slot-level KV reuse** | Single slot | In-memory (KV cache) | Automatic via `n_past = get_common_prefix()` |
| **Cross-slot prompt cache** | All slots | In-memory (LRU deque) | Automatic on slot reuse when `f_keep < 0.5` |
| **Slot file save/restore** | Single slot | Disk (explicit file) | Manual via HTTP endpoint |
| **Speculative checkpoints** | Single slot | In-memory (per-draft) | Automatic during speculative decoding |

---
